prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 9 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1074; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck on the driver side while turning left. The patient reported an outstretched-hand fall with immediate pain and swelling of the left wrist. Imaging confirmed a distal radius fracture, and the examination findings were consistent with that diagnosis. The mechanism and force of the impact are well matched to this type of injury. No prior injury to the same area is known from the history obtained. Care consisted of immobilization, pain management, and a graduated course of hand therapy over nine visits. Symptoms and range of motion improved steadily, and visit frequency tapered as healing progressed. Billing records reflect single charges for each service with no repeated entries. Patient was discharged from active treatment with a plan for follow-up as needed.
